activeSlice.scope: Repair Hunter V2 shadow retrieval/ranking wiring exposed by the completed 30-pair operational evidence: prevent empty RSS success from starving Agent Reach, add a bounded lexical adjacent-exploration retrieval intent, reserve one exploration slot in the six-intent operational plan, and preserve exploration provenance into EEI bucketing. Do not change rollout thresholds, production Hunter authority, persistence, canary, scheduler, or production enablement.
successCriteria: The operational V2 lane attempts enough bounded sources for Industry news / Official source plans that Agent Reach is not starved behind empty RSS.
Hunter retrieval planning includes a lexical adjacent-exploration intent while retaining semantic expansion as an optional additional intent.
The balanced operational plan reserves exactly one lexical adjacent-exploration slot when available and remains within maxIntents.
Exploration-only retrieval provenance survives trend clustering and multistage ranking.
EEI classifies explicitly exploration-only candidates into the exploration bucket without weakening manipulation, negative-preference, saturation, or topic-concentration controls.
A production-like adapter test demonstrates non-zero V2 retrieval coverage, non-zero V2 cost when Agent Reach is used, and at least one exploration recommendation.
The same 3-brand / 30-pair shadow gate is rerun after deployment with all HI2-09 rollout thresholds unchanged.
Hunter V1 remains production authority and V2 performs no opportunity persistence.
Canary and production activation remain disabled unless the completed rerun passes the existing rollout evaluator.
PES v2 CI and Security baseline pass before merge/deployment.
